data.name: Rabia
data.gender_notes: Rabia is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ب-ع (r-b-ʿ), 'four'; rabīʿ means 'spring'. Its root is ر-ب-ع (r-b-ʿ). Borne by Rābiʿa al-ʿAdawiyya, a famous Sufi saint. Rabia is a Arabic name meaning “Spring; fourth (daughter)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rabia expresses “Spring; fourth (daughter)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ر-ب-ع (r-b-ʿ), 'four'; rabīʿ means 'spring'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rabia total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
